summary.text: Chad Caldwell represents District 40 in the Oklahoma House of Representatives and has lived in Enid since 2005. He is vice chair of the House Education Oversight Committee and chairs the Appropriations and Budget Education Subcommittee.

paragraphs.text: Caldwell grew up in Colorado and has called Enid home since 2005.
He attended both undergraduate and graduate school at the University of Oklahoma in Norman.

Caldwell has served as Executive Director of Hospice Circle of Love since 2009, and before that worked with the University of Oklahoma Athletic Department, the Garth Brooks Teammates for Kids Foundation and Frantz Insurance Agency.
He has served as an honorary wing commander at Vance Air Force Base and on the boards of several state and local nonprofit organizations.
He serves on the Southern Regional Education Board, a position he was first appointed to in 2016.
He and his wife, an Enid native, have three children.

sources.title: Representative Chad Caldwell (Oklahoma House of Representatives)
